faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Here are common questions about washing machine and dishwasher repair in Mekkah.
faq.q1: Do you repair washing machines in Mekkah?
faq.a1: Yes. We repair washing machines for common issues such as drum problems, water leakage, motor faults, vibration, and electrical failures.
faq.q2: How fast can you send a technician for washing machine repair?
faq.a2: We usually offer same-day or next-day service across Mekkah. Contact us on WhatsApp or call +966541638686 to confirm your appointment quickly.
faq.q3: Do you repair dishwashers as well?
faq.a3: Yes. We provide dishwasher repair for spray arm issues, heater problems, leaks, poor cleaning performance, and cycle failures.
faq.q4: How much does washing machine or dishwasher repair cost?
faq.a4: The cost depends on the fault and the required parts. We charge a fixed 50 SAR visit and inspection fee, and we provide a clear quote before any repair begins.
faq.q5: Do you use genuine spare parts for washing machine and dishwasher repairs?
faq.a5: Yes. We use genuine and high-quality spare parts to ensure reliable repairs and long-lasting performance.
faq.q6: Which areas in Mekkah do you cover for appliance repair?
faq.a6: We serve all major neighborhoods in Mekkah, including Al Rawdah, Al Salamah, Al Hamra, Al Nuzha, Al Aziziyah, Obhur, Al Faisaliyah, Al Zahra, Al Safa, Al Andalus, Al Shati, and the Corniche.
faq.q7: Is your service available for urgent repairs?
faq.a7: Yes. We provide urgent support for washing machine and dishwasher repairs and are available 24/7 through call or WhatsApp at +966541638686.
